title: A Comprehensive Exploration of African Mythologies

traditions.name: Egyptian
traditions.focus: Maintenance of Ma'at (cosmic order) against chaos.
traditions.narrative: The Osiris myth involving death, resurrection, and the triumph of Horus.

traditions.name: Yoruba
traditions.hierarchy: Supreme being Olodumare with intermediary spirits called Orishas.
traditions.practice: Ifa divination used to communicate with the divine.

traditions.name: Kongo
traditions.symbol: The Dikenga cosmogram representing the cyclical journey of the soul.

traditions.name: Maasai
traditions.deity: Enkai (or Ngai), with dual aspects: Enkai Narok (Black/Benevolent) and Enkai Nanyokie (Red/Vengeful).
traditions.cattle: Cattle are considered a sacred gift and trust from Enkai.
